QuestInfo.name: [Limina] The Final Foe
QuestInfo.0:
The final operation of the Alliance is to take the White Spear carrying the Maple Warrior to the Black Mage. This is the reason why the power of the White Spear was preserved.
The heroes of the Alliance arrive before the Black Mage as planned.
QuestInfo.1: This is now the final part. Talk to Empress Cygnus and go to everyone's side. It's now time to defeat the #rBlack Mage#k.
QuestInfo.2: You finally succeeded in defeating the #rBlack Mage#k. But... It seems you have vanished.
